name: Mallsoft
summary: Empty shopping malls and lobbies in dull light, in photos that look like they date from the 1980s and 1990s. The pictures go with mall music and evoke loneliness and a cold, corporate space.

philosophy.core_thesis: A mall with no people is a memory of a public place that sells and does not speak: the viewer feels at home and alone at once.
design_principles: Use one photo of a mall interior from the 1980s or 1990s as the focal image, and set it at 70% to 85% of the viewport width.
Fade the photo: lower the contrast by 10% to 20%, warm the shadows and add a grain of 3% to 6%.
Set the ground in pale peach (#EFE4D6) with a floor of square tiles in 64px to 96px steps.
Use cool tube-light white (#F7FBFF) for the text panels and keep body text at 16px with a contrast of 7:1 or more.
Set headlines in a quiet geometric sans-serif at normal tracking, in lower case, with a small shop-sign tag above.
Add one line of fake mall notice text, such as an opening time or a floor name, under each main heading.
Leave 40% to 55% of the surface empty, so that the page feels like a hall with no people.
anti_patterns: Statues, sun discs and perspective grids

layout.grid_mechanics: A calm 12-column grid with 32px gutters; one large photo spans 8 columns and a narrow text panel spans 4 columns.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 40% to 55% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32 and 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush-left headlines and panels; the photo sits off centre, as a view down a hall.
layout.container_geometry: Panels with a 2px radius and a 1px pale edge; photo frames with a square corner; thin rules like shop-front edges.

font_pairings.note: A geometric display face that echoes mall sign lettering, with a calm text face.
A thin, wide-set face for floor signs, with a neutral text face.
A round, friendly sign face for a soft corporate tone.

typography.tracking: Display takes 0.02em; small tags take 0.14em; body stays at 0.01em.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and semibold (600).
Put a small upper-case tag with a floor or shop name above each main heading.

color.palette_structure: Pale peach and warm beige for the hall, cool tube white for the panels, with a muted teal and a dusty rose as the only accents.
color.contrast_rules: Text on peach marble holds at least 7:1; teal and rose carry headings and tags, not long text.
color.surface_treatment: Flat pale colour with a faint tile pattern; photos with a faded, warm cast and fine grain.
color.light_and_shadow: Even overhead light with no hard shadow; a soft glow of 1px to 2px at the edge of panels.

materiality.surface_simulation: A mall hall: polished tile floors, glass shop fronts, brushed metal rails and a ceiling of tube lights.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px pale-grey rule on panels; a 2px rule under headings like a shop-front edge.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur; panels sit flat with a 2px soft shadow at 8% opacity.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Thin outline icons at 24px with round terminals, in the style of mall directory signs: stairs, lift, bag, fountain.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Faded photos and video stills of mall halls, fountains, escalators and closed shop fronts; no drawn figures.

motion.transition_physics: Very slow, steady drifts: the photo pans by 2% in 30s; panels fade in over 800ms; no bounce.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lowers the contrast of the photo by 5% and underlines the label; active state darkens the panel by 4%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels a calm, lonely nostalgia for a public place that no longer exists.

use_cases: video essays on retail and consumer culture
art and zine pages about public space
avoid_when: The page must sell a product with urgency.
The audience needs a bright, active tone.
The page needs dense, fast reading.

modifiers.how: Replace the peach with a violet ground; add a pink to cyan gradient, a perspective floor and a glow on headings.
Replace the faded photo with a bright 3D render; use sky blue and white with glossy panels.
Replace the mall photo with a warm anime sunset still; add pink and teal and a rounded sans face.

pack.why: Thin outline icons with round ends read like the pictograms on a mall directory.

ground.why: A mall hall is a floor of square tiles under tube light; the ground repeats that floor.

tailwind.classes: rounded-sm border border-[#B0576B] bg-[#2F6F73] px-6 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-[#EFE4D6]
